name: assayer
description: Evidence-backed audits for web interfaces and installed plugins in Codex

interface.shortDescription: Audit web interfaces and drive installed plugins with evidence-backed checks.
interface.longDescription: Assayer guides Codex through bounded, evidence-backed audits. It can inspect a real web interface or drive any installed plugin through the domain-neutral plugin lifecycle, then produce traceable findings and reports from a natural-language request.
defaultPrompt: Audit this web URL for frontend issues: <URL>
Run the installed plugin for this input and produce an evidence-backed report.
Continue the Assayer audit and explain the current progress.
Explain the Assayer result and what I should do next.
